newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico seizes cocaine on German boat, 14 held.
newsitem.headline: Mexico seizes cocaine on German boat, 14 held.

text.p: Mexican authorities seized more than a ton of cocaine from a German ship and detained 14 foreign crewmen -- including seven Germans -- for questioning, the government said on Monday.
The Attorney General's Office said police and military personnel raided the German-flagged container ship near the west coast port of Manzanillo on Saturday and found drugs stashed in boxes of books.
It said the haul of 1.145 tons of cocaine was one of the biggest this year in Mexico.
The Attorney General's Office said in a statement that the ship had travelled from the Colombian port of Buenaventura to Manzanillo.
The crew of the TMM Jalisco consisted of seven Germans, two Poles and five Philippines nationals.
Mexican transportation company, Transportacion Maritima Mexicana, S.A. (TMM) said in a statement it regretted that one of its chartered ships was used to transport drugs.
TMM added that it would cooperate fully with authorities.
The ship is registered in the German port of Leer and owned by the Atlas Trampship Reederei company, according to Lloyd's Register of Ships.
